added_text:
## Maintenance Patch v4.12.3 — Notification Badge Fix
Resolved a race condition in the Electron desktop wrapper where unread mention counters failed to clear after switching workspaces rapidly. Also patched a crash affecting Wayland Linux users during screen sharing cleanup.

## Stability Update v4.12.2 — WebSocket Reconnect Hardening
Fixed an issue where mobile clients remained stuck in 'Connecting...' after transitioning from corporate Wi-Fi to cellular LTE. Reduced duplicate push notification deliveries on iOS 19 devices.

## Patch Release v4.12.1 — Search Index Sync Fix
Addressed an indexing delay that caused edited thread messages to appear with stale text in global search results for up to ten minutes. Corrected timezone offset rendering in CSV message export logs.

## Hotfix v4.12.0 — Memory Leak in Media Previews
Eliminated a memory leak triggered when scrolling rapidly through channels containing large inline PNG screenshots. Fixed keyboard focus trapping inside the emoji reaction picker on Firefox.

## Reliability Patch — Webhook Retry Queue Correction
Fixed a bug where failed outbound webhooks returned HTTP 429 retries without honoring the Retry-After header. Resolved an edge case where deleted draft messages reappeared after browser refresh.

## Desktop Bug Fix — Tray Icon & Auto-Updater
Fixed a Windows 11 system tray icon blur issue on 150% DPI scaling displays and resolved an updater permission prompt error for standard non-admin accounts. No user workflow changes are included in this patch.

## Engineering Essay: Why Async Thread Summaries Matter in 2027
In this week's engineering blog post, our product research team explores how distributed startups suffer from thread overload and debates theoretical design patterns for AI summarization tools—no product changes are shipping yet.

## Customer Spotlight: How Northstar Robotics Runs Daily Standups
Read our new case study profiling how a 45-person robotics team uses existing Locus channels and manual checklists to coordinate firmware releases across Munich and Austin.

## We Are Hiring Principal Distributed Systems Engineers
Locus is expanding our core messaging infrastructure group across North America and Europe. If you love Rust, Raft consensus, and low-latency WebSockets, visit our careers page to meet the team and apply.

## Thinking About Self-Hosted Security: Lessons From Our Advisory Board
Our CISO shares reflections from a recent roundtable on why regulated engineering organizations care about VPC isolation, air-gapped deployments, and auditability—without announcing any new deployment product.

## Community Meetup Recap: Building Developer Tools in Berlin
Thank you to the 180 engineers who joined our autumn systems engineering meetup last Thursday. Slides and lightning talk recordings covering Go profiling and local-first databases are now posted on our community hub.

## Annual Transparency & Reliability Report 2026
We published our yearly operational review detailing 99.98% message delivery uptime, zero security incidents, and our roadmap philosophy for keeping team chat calm and predictable next year.

## Visual Refresh — Sidebar Typography & Spacing
Updated channel list font weights, tightened vertical row padding by 2 pixels, and introduced softer slate divider hairlines across the workspace sidebar for calmer visual contrast during long sessions.

## Brand Polish — Updated App Icon & Loading Skeleton
Refreshed the desktop dock icon with updated geometric proportions and replaced the legacy spinner animation with a neutral shimmer skeleton while threads hydrate on slow networks.

## Pricing Page Copy & Card Alignment Update
Reordered bullet points across the Free, Team, and Enterprise columns for clearer side-by-side reading and updated button labels from 'Start Trial' to 'Create Workspace' with identical underlying plan entitlements.

## UI Polish — Refined Thread Drawer Borders
Adjusted border radius tokens on modal dialogs and refined timestamp contrast ratios in light theme so secondary metadata passes WCAG AA legibility guidelines across calibrated monitors.

## Header Navigation Rearrangement
Moved the Help Center link from the top navigation bar into the workspace profile dropdown menu and standardized button corner radii across settings tabs without altering functionality.

## Updated Customer Logos & Typography on Pricing
Replaced legacy partner logo SVGs in the social proof strip below the pricing grid and bumped section headings by 2px for improved visual hierarchy on ultrawide desktop displays.

## Team Plan Billing Adjustment — Annual vs. Monthly Rates
Effective January 1, 2027, the Team plan monthly rate changes from $8 to $10 per active user per month, while annual prepayment remains locked at $8 per user per month with no changes to included features.

## Enterprise Minimum Seat Requirement Update
Updated Enterprise contract terms to require a 25-seat minimum commitment on new annual agreements and introduced quarterly invoicing options in EUR and GBP alongside USD.

## Academic & Non-Profit Discount Policy Clarification
Verified non-profit organizations and university research labs now receive a flat 40% discount on Team and Enterprise subscriptions; all included product capabilities remain unchanged.

## Fair-Billing Proration Policy Update
We updated our billing FAQ to clarify automated seat credits when team members become inactive for 14 consecutive days, ensuring organizations only pay for active monthly contributors.

## Startup Program Credits Extension
Eligible seed-stage startups affiliated with partner incubators can now apply a $1,000 billing credit toward their first year on the Team tier without altering plan limits or product features.

## Multi-Year Enterprise Price Lock Guarantee
Organizations signing 24-month or 36-month Enterprise agreements before quarter-end receive a contractual renewal price cap of 3% annually with identical feature entitlements.

## November 20, 2026 — One-Click Thread Summarization
Locus now ships built-in one-click thread summaries across every channel and direct message thread. Engineers can condense 200-message incident threads into decisions, owners, and open blockers in under two seconds.

## November 19, 2026 — Two-Way GitHub & Jira Sync
Connect repositories and Jira boards directly to Locus channels starting today. Engineers can approve pull requests, transition Jira ticket statuses, and comment on issues without leaving their chat threads.

## November 18, 2026 — Self-Hosted Docker & Kubernetes Edition
Locus Self-Hosted is now generally available as a single-command Docker Compose bundle and Helm chart. Privacy-focused engineering teams can deploy Locus inside air-gapped VPCs with zero external telemetry.

feature_name: Unlimited Message History on Free Tier
added_text:
## Free Tier Feature Expansion — Unlimited Message History
- Unlimited searchable message history is now live for every Free workspace, removing the previous 90-day retention cap.
- Teams also receive 150 MB file attachments on the Free plan at no extra cost.

## November 17, 2026 — 500 MB Engineering Artifact Sharing
All paid and trial Locus workspaces can now upload build logs, crash dumps, and screen recordings up to 500 MB per file. Uploaded archives include inline previewers for JSON traces and zip manifests.

feature_name: Live Voice Huddles with Screen Share
added_text:
## November 16, 2026 — Live Voice Huddles with Screen Share
Start lightweight audio huddles directly inside any Locus channel with low-latency cursor-annotated screen sharing. Huddles support up to 15 concurrent engineers without spinning up an external video meeting link.

## November 15, 2026 — Automated On-Call Pager Escalation
Locus Incident Channels now ship automated escalation policies that page secondary engineers if an alert goes unacknowledged for five minutes. Acknowledge or silence pages via slash commands right inside the thread.

## November 14, 2026 — Cross-Workspace Shared Channels
Collaborate with external contractors and partner engineering teams using federated shared channels. Admins retain full message retention policies and can revoke external domain access in one click.

## November 13, 2026 — Semantic Channel Search
Locus Search now supports natural-language queries across historical channels, attachments, and code blocks. Ask questions like 'how did we rotate the staging Redis keys' and jump straight to the resolved thread.

## Team Plan Addition — Zero-Config Slack Migration Importer
- Added a guided self-serve migration importer that transfers channels, threaded replies, emoji reactions, and user mappings in under ten minutes.
- Preserves original timestamps and private channel membership rules automatically.

## November 12, 2026 — Workflow Automations Builder
Build no-code channel triggers that route bug reports, collect standup updates, and post daily release checklists automatically. Templates for engineering triage and onboarding are available immediately in workspace settings.

## November 11, 2026 — Enterprise FINRA & SEC Compliance Exports
Enterprise financial institutions can now enable WORM-compliant archival exports to Smarsh and Global Relay. Requires an Enterprise contract with dedicated compliance administrator provisioning.

## November 9, 2026 — Custom SAML Attribute Role Mapping
Identity administrators on Enterprise plans can now map Okta and Azure AD group attributes directly to Locus channel security groups. Role updates propagate during the next SAML assertion refresh.

feature_name: Desktop Status Sync with Apple Focus
added_text:
## November 7, 2026 — Desktop Status Sync with Apple Focus
Our macOS desktop client now syncs your availability status automatically with macOS Focus modes. When Deep Work Focus is active on your Mac, Locus sets your presence to Do Not Disturb.

## Enterprise Plan Addition — Multi-Region EU/APAC Data Pinning
- Enterprise customers can now select Frankfurt, Tokyo, or Sydney storage regions for workspace backups and search indexes.
- Available at provisioning for organizations exceeding 500 licensed seats.

## November 6, 2026 — Custom Animated Workspace Emoji Packs
Workspace members can now upload WebP animated emoji packs and organize team reactions into shared folders. Includes bulk ZIP import and reaction usage analytics for community managers.
